# Saipem: divestment of Shallow Water Drilling's operations in Saudi Arabia completed
Tue, 09/15/2026 - 07:30

[Share](https://www.saipem.com/en/media/press-releases/2026-09-15/saipem-divestment-shallow-water-drillings-operations-saudi-arabia#)

[Linkedin](https://www.saipem.com/en/media/press-releases/2026-09-15/saipem-divestment-shallow-water-drillings-operations-saudi-arabia#) [Facebook](https://www.saipem.com/en/media/press-releases/2026-09-15/saipem-divestment-shallow-water-drillings-operations-saudi-arabia#) [Whatsapp](https://www.saipem.com/en/media/press-releases/2026-09-15/saipem-divestment-shallow-water-drillings-operations-saudi-arabia#) [Email](https://www.saipem.com/en/media/press-releases/2026-09-15/saipem-divestment-shallow-water-drillings-operations-saudi-arabia#) [Copy Link](https://www.saipem.com/en/media/press-releases/2026-09-15/saipem-divestment-shallow-water-drillings-operations-saudi-arabia#)

_Milan (Italy), 15 September 2026_ – Saipem announces that it has completed the sale of its entire shareholding in Saudi Arabian Saipem Limited to ADES Saudi Limited Company, an indirect subsidiary of ADES Holding Company, an international operator active worldwide in offshore and onshore drilling services.
